name: LPA KIV-2 (HPRC rGFA)
description: chr6:160,525,000-160,655,000 of the HPRC release 2 Minigraph-Cactus graph: the kringle IV-2 repeat forms the loops.

name: LPA KIV-2, 8 samples
description: Cut at base level from the HPRC release 2 gbz-base database by range requests; walk rows read the repeat's copy number as bar length.

name: C4 duplication, 4 samples
description: The complement C4 region cut from the HPRC gbz-base database.

name: Amylase locus, 4 samples
description: AMY2B through AMY1C cut from the HPRC gbz-base database; walk rows box each haplotype's own genes, one to four AMY1 copies.

name: MHC class II (HPRC rGFA)
description: chr6:32,510,000-32,600,000: the DRB haplotypes, dozens of alleles.

name: CFH deletion (HPRC rGFA)
description: chr1:196,640,000-196,900,000: an 84 kb deletion drawn as a bare edge.

name: AMY1B to AMY1C (HPRC rGFA)
description: chr1:103,690,000-103,780,000: an rGFA has no walks, so the amylase copies show only as edges turning back along the backbone.

name: chr1 cut, 161 walks (CHM13 + GRCh38 + HPRC)
description: A base-level chr1 cut whose W lines put CHM13, GRCh38 and HPRC haplotypes through it; the reference comes from the walks.

name: Assembly graph, 64 contigs
description: A de novo assembly graph with k-mer depths, the kind Bandage was built for: no reference, so force-directed is the one layout.

name: E. coli minigraph (rGFA)
description: A slice of an E. coli pangenome built with minigraph, anchored on K-12, with its NCBI genes from the K-12 GenArk hub.

name: E. coli pggb subgraph (P lines)
description: A small base-level pggb graph whose coordinates come from its paths.

name: Cactus BRCA2 cut with NA12879 reads
description: Nodes 240–280 of the cactus BRCA2 graph with the NA12879 reads vg giraffe aligned over them: the tube map draws each read with its mismatches, and the other layouts widen a node by its coverage.
